text: T14, two items. (1) Fix your own oracle defect: check_deaths applies the run-wide kt_recv_applied total to both lanes, so 'pushed, never applied' passes for the wrong reason - join death-recv objIds per lane. (2) Verify RE's discriminator in one run: dump kind/role from entity+0x9C for every enumerated NPC in a civilian street, a guard post and a mixed market; PASS if every attacker is (kind=3,role=1) and every fleer is (2,2). RE's refs: sub_73B4B0 guard, sub_54EC00 civilian, table sub_1406C70.
